body:
sam (product): quick sync — a few customers pushing for strict structured output guarantees. question: do we ship "JSON Schema validation + auto-retry" in first beta or keep it experimental?
linh (eng-api): short answer: prefer opt-in beta. full enforcement affects latency/throughput and error semantics.
elaine (eng-ml): +1. validation-on-read vs validation-on-generate tradeoffs. if we validate post-hoc and retry, we can keep runtime simple but need deterministic retry policy.
praveen (support): customer ask: 'we need schema validation that fails loudly for auditing, and an automatic retry with altered prompt if structure invalid.' many legal/reg customers want non-silent failures.
molly (pm): proposed launch criteria: 1) spec for schema attachment in request 2) default validation mode = warn (non-blocking) 3) opt-in strict mode = block & retry 4) docs + quickstart + sample evals.
linh (eng-api): implementation notes: we can implement 2 modes: warn and strict. warn: include validation result in response metadata. strict: detect invalid, perform up to N retries with adjusted prompt. need SLO trade analysis.
elaine (eng-ml): retry strategy sketch: on invalid JSON -> send repaired prompt that includes the original model output in a code block + explicit instructions + schema example. fallback = call smaller verifier model to patch. any auto-patching must be logged.
sam (product): priority question: is strict mode blocking for GA? customers in finance want it GA, early startups okay with warn-only.
molly (pm): propose scope split: GA = warn + docs + SDK helpers. Beta for strict + auto-repair with feature flag and opt-in.
linh (eng-api): rough perf numbers to consider: naive validation adds ~5-30ms per request for small schemas; retries add full generation cost (~50-200ms) depending on model. batching interaction gets trickier.
praveen (support): also need observability: per-request validation status, sample invalid outputs, and a replayable prompt to debug.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/structured-output-schema-check -> staging in 3h :rocket:
elaine (eng-ml): security note: when including prior output in prompt for patching, redact any sensitive fields. add a flag to control whether we include full output.
molly (pm): ACTIONS: @linh scoping doc for API shape + flags (warn|strict|repair) by EOD Thurs. @elaine write retry recipe + sample patches. @praveen list top 5 customer requirements for failure semantics. @sam collect priority customers who need GA.
sam (product): also need acceptance tests: 1) schema mismatch returns validation metadata 2) strict+retry eventually returns valid JSON for X% of cases on eval dataset 3) audit log exists.
linh (eng-api): will add API surface: body param "schema" accepts JSON Schema draft-07 string or URL; optional "mode": "warn"|"strict"|"repair"; "max_retries": int. will prototype default behaviour as warn.
elaine (eng-ml): for repair flow, propose a lightweight verifier model (distilled) to predict repair patches before full regen to save cost. experiment in alpha.
praveen (support): thumbs: :thumbsup: documenting clear error codes will reduce tickets. include examples for common mismatch errors.
molly (pm): negotiate with sales: beta strict available to select enterprise accounts only. public GA after 2 weeks of beta telemetry and safety review.
sam (product): sounds good. keeping strict opt-in reduces risk and helps negotiate launch promises. thanks team.
linh (eng-api): will drop initial PR and RFC this afternoon. I'll ping here when ready for review.
praveen (support): adding one more ask: a webhook alert for repeated validation failures per customer (helps SRE/support).
molly (pm): noted. adding to acceptance checklist.
sam (product): end of thread — will compile and send to roadmap doc. :white_check_mark:
